steps.title: Taste the Stars
steps.text: The Ascendancy must know what lies beyond the home crust. Chart five systems.

steps.title: A Second Feast
steps.text: One world is never enough. Hold three systems.

steps.title: Deep Rendering
steps.text: Reach the mantle and the hunger will be satisfied for a season. Research Deep Extraction.

steps.title: Read the Lanes
steps.text: The Exodus trusts only what it has seen. Chart six systems.

steps.title: Build the Vault
steps.text: Every world left behind must be remembered. Build a Memory Vault.

steps.title: Harsh Country
steps.text: Learn to settle the worlds nobody else wants. Research Harsh World Habitats.

steps.title: Open Hands
steps.text: The Concord persuades by example. Bank 150 Dust.

steps.title: A Voice in the Senate
steps.text: Policy is the Concord's weapon. Pass a law.

steps.title: The Envoy
steps.text: Someone must carry the Accord abroad. Recruit a hero.

steps.title: Seed Capital
steps.text: Nothing moves without money. Hold 400 Dust.

steps.title: The Bourse
steps.text: A proper exchange, with a roof. Build the Syndicate Bourse.

steps.title: Lanes of Commerce
steps.text: Trade needs routes. Research Trade Networks.

steps.title: First Hulls
steps.text: A foundry without ships is a shrine without worshippers. Field three warships.

steps.title: The Great Foundry
steps.text: Raise the cathedral of fire. Build the Great Foundry.

steps.title: Proof of Steel
steps.text: Steel must be tested. Win a battle.

steps.title: Axioms
steps.text: Every proof begins with definitions. Research three technologies.

steps.title: Lemma
steps.text: The Chorus needs more voices. Reach twelve population.

steps.title: Resonance
steps.text: Amplify the Chorus. Build the Resonance Spire.
